screening: English official Output section manually reviewed for a unique deterministic integer/fixed-string result; tolerance, real-number, interactive, and constructive/multiple-valid-output tasks excluded.
submission_selection: Deterministic stratified sampling by language followed by greedy diversity over language, source-size band, and normalized token 4-shingles.
